title: UVs and texture detail
summary: How you unwrap: seams, how evenly texture detail is spread, how much of the UV space you fill, and how many pixels per metre you aim for.

request.brief: Submit a game-ready prop with its UVs finished the way you ship them, with the material and texture size you'd use (an image texture node with the right resolution is enough).
must_include: Finished UVs on the mesh you'd export
Your seams marked if you mark them
The texture size you target (an image or a note)

questions.ask: What texture size do you usually target for a prop this size?
Do you work to a fixed texel density? If so, what (px per metre, at which texture size)?
Which UV tools do you use? (Blender only, UVPackmaster, RizomUV, Zen UV, other)
